title: Fix duplicated billing from concurrent usage merge across Hosted and Dedicated
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several paying customers reported inflated token usage for short windows. Investigation shows duplicated TokenUsage rows were created when the billing-merge job processed overlapping ingest and replay streams. This ticket tracks the hotfix, backfill, and permanent fixes plus customer communications and credits.
detection: Anomaly alerts from billing-pipeline and multiple CS escalations. Correlation between billing-alerts and increases in billing.duplicate_records metric. Manual inspection of metering-db showed repeated TokenUsage entries with the same minute_window and tenant_id but different record_ids.
reproduction_steps: Start a mixed load test with live requests + client-side retries to generate cache-replay within 60s windows.
Run billing-merge-service concurrently with ingest to simulate race conditions.
Query metering-db for TokenUsage by tenant and minute_window and observe duplicated totals for identical logical requests.
root_cause_summary: Race condition in billing-merge-service deduplication logic. Deduplication key omitted request_id in some code paths, using only tenant_id+minute_window which allowed replayed requests to be aggregated rather than deduplicated. Additionally, metering-db writes used a non-idempotent upsert pattern across shards leading to double-counting during shard reconciliation.
mitigations: Hotfix: include request_id in dedupe key and change write to idempotent upsert (replace-if-exists) in metering-db - deployed to canary tenants.
Short-term: enable single-threaded merge mode for affected tenant groups to eliminate concurrent merges until backfill completes.
Customer action: provisional credits issued to impacted accounts and CS notified.
plan: Run backfill job to reconcile duplicated TokenUsage rows for last 7 days - scheduled 2026-03-12; monitor at 25% then scale to 75% throughput.
Add unit/integration tests covering concurrent merge + replay scenarios and ensure request_id dedupe behavior.
Add observability: billing.duplicate_records metric, Grafana panel, and PagerDuty alert at >5 duplicates/min per tenant.
Implement permanent change to merge pipeline: idempotent upserts, write-intent log, stronger shard-consistency checks.
status_notes: Hotfix deployed to canary; after 2 hours no duplicates observed. Backfill running at 60% and expected to complete in 18 hours. Finance preparing final credit calculations. Need SRE sign-off before rolling single-threaded mode back to default.
